task: Write a single TypeScript function parseS3Uri(uri: string): { bucket: string; key: string } | null. Accept only s3:// URIs with a nonempty bucket and a nonempty key separated by the first slash. Preserve additional slashes in the key, do not URL-decode, and return null for other inputs. Do not validate AWS bucket naming rules or make network calls.

Write a single TypeScript function getTagValue(tags: { Key?: string; Value?: string }[], key: string): string | undefined. Return the Value of the first AWS tag whose Key exactly matches key, or undefined if there is no match. Do not mutate the input.

Write a single TypeScript function getRunningInstanceIds(instances: { InstanceId?: string; State?: { Name?: string } }[]): string[]. Return IDs of EC2 instances whose state is running, skipping missing IDs and preserving input order.

Write a single TypeScript function buildSqsBatchFailures(records: { messageId: string }[], failedIds: string[]): { batchItemFailures: { itemIdentifier: string }[] }. Include only records whose messageId appears in failedIds, preserving record order. Assume record IDs are unique; ignore failedIds not present in records.

Write a single TypeScript function decodeS3EventKey(encodedKey: string): string. Decode an S3 event object key by replacing plus signs with spaces before applying decodeURIComponent. Allow malformed percent escapes to throw the standard decoding error.

Write a single TypeScript function ttlFromNow(nowSeconds: number, lifetimeSeconds: number): number. Return a DynamoDB TTL Unix timestamp by adding the two inputs. Assume both inputs are nonnegative integers measured in seconds; do not read the system clock.

Write a single TypeScript function buildLambdaJsonResponse(statusCode: number, payload: unknown): { statusCode: number; headers: Record<string, string>; body: string }. Return an API Gateway proxy response with Content-Type set to application/json and a JSON-stringified body. Assume payload is JSON-serializable and is not undefined.

Write a single TypeScript function getAwsAccountId(arn: string): string | null. Split an ARN into colon-separated components and return the fifth component only if the first component is arn and the fifth component is exactly 12 ASCII digits. Return null otherwise; do not validate the remaining ARN components.

Write a single TypeScript function groupS3KeysByPrefix(keys: string[]): Record<string, string[]>. Group each key by the substring before its first slash; use an empty string for keys without a slash. Preserve key order within each group and safely support prefixes such as __proto__.

Write a single TypeScript function toCloudWatchDimensions(values: Record<string, string>): { Name: string; Value: string }[]. Convert each own enumerable entry into a CloudWatch dimension and sort the result by Name in ascending ASCII order. Assume names contain only ASCII characters.

Write a single TypeScript function getDynamoString(item: Record<string, { S?: string }>, attribute: string): string | undefined. Return the S value of the requested DynamoDB attribute, including an empty string when present, or undefined when the attribute or S value is absent.

Write a single TypeScript function chunkForSqs<T>(items: T[]): T[][]. Split items into batches of at most 10 entries for SQS SendMessageBatch. Preserve order, do not mutate the input, and return an empty array for empty input.

Write a single TypeScript function getFailedEventBridgeIndexes(entries: { ErrorCode?: string }[]): number[]. Return the zero-based indexes of PutEvents result entries with a nonempty ErrorCode, preserving ascending index order.

Write a single TypeScript function getSnsMessages(records: { Sns?: { Message?: string } }[]): string[]. Extract present SNS Message strings from Lambda records, including empty strings, skipping missing values and preserving order.

Write a single TypeScript function buildSecretArn(region: string, accountId: string, secretResourceName: string): string. Construct an ARN in the aws partition for Secrets Manager using these inputs. secretResourceName already includes the AWS-generated suffix; preserve it exactly. Assume all inputs are valid.

Write a single TypeScript function totalS3ObjectBytes(objects: { Size?: number }[]): number. Sum the Size values from an S3 ListObjectsV2 result, treating missing sizes as zero. Return zero for an empty array and assume present sizes are nonnegative finite numbers.

Write a single TypeScript function getApiGatewayHeader(headers: Record<string, string | undefined>, name: string): string | undefined. Find the first own enumerable header whose name matches case-insensitively and return its value. Return undefined when absent; assume there are no case-insensitive duplicate header names.

Return a single JSON object containing an IAM identity policy with Version 2012-10-17 and one Allow statement. Permit only s3:GetObject on objects under arn:aws:s3:::training-assets/reports/*. Do not include Principal or grant access to the bucket itself.

Return a single JSON object containing an IAM role trust policy with Version 2012-10-17 and one Allow statement. Allow only the lambda.amazonaws.com service principal to perform sts:AssumeRole, with no conditions.

Return a single JSON object containing an EventBridge event pattern. Match source aws.ec2, detail-type EC2 Instance State-change Notification, and detail.state equal to either running or stopped. Use the exact EventBridge event-pattern field names.
Return a single JSON object containing an EventBridge event pattern. Match source aws.s3, detail-type Object Created, and detail.bucket.name equal to training-uploads. Do not add other filters.

Return a single JSON object containing an API Gateway Lambda proxy response with statusCode 200, a headers object setting Content-Type to application/json, isBase64Encoded false, and a body string that encodes the JSON object {"ok":true}.

Return a single JSON object containing the DynamoDB low-level AttributeValue representation of an item with userId equal to user-42, loginCount equal to numeric 3, and active equal to boolean true. Use S, N, and BOOL respectively, and do not wrap the item in an Item property.

Return a single JSON object containing an S3 lifecycle configuration with one enabled rule. Give the rule ID expire-temp, filter the prefix temp/, and expire current objects after 7 days. Use the shape accepted by PutBucketLifecycleConfiguration and omit bucket identification.

Return a single JSON object containing an S3 CORS configuration with one rule. Allow origin https://app.example.com, methods GET and HEAD, all request headers, and MaxAgeSeconds 3000. Use the shape accepted by PutBucketCors and omit bucket identification.

Return a single JSON object containing the JSON policy string contents referenced by the SQS RedrivePolicy attribute: deadLetterTargetArn must be arn:aws:sqs:us-east-1:123456789012:training-dlq and maxReceiveCount must be the string 5. Return the inner policy object, not a string or an attributes wrapper.

Return a single JSON object containing a Step Functions state machine definition. Start at MarkReady, use one Pass state named MarkReady that returns {"status":"ready"}, and end execution in that state. Do not include deployment metadata.

Return a single JSON object containing a Step Functions state machine definition. Start at WaitBriefly, wait for 5 seconds in a Wait state, then transition to a Succeed state named Done. Include exactly these two states.

Return a single JSON object containing a CloudFormation template with AWSTemplateFormatVersion 2010-09-09 and one resource named WorkQueue of type AWS::SQS::Queue. Set QueueName to training-work and VisibilityTimeout to 45. Do not include other resources.

Return a single JSON object containing a CloudWatch PutMetricData request. Use Namespace Training/App and one MetricData entry with MetricName JobsProcessed, Value 1, Unit Count, and one dimension named Environment with value dev. Omit timestamps.

Return a single JSON object containing a Lambda SQS partial batch response that marks only message IDs msg-2 and msg-5 as failed, in that order. Use batchItemFailures and itemIdentifier with their exact required casing.

Return a single JSON object containing an IAM identity policy with Version 2012-10-17 and one Allow statement. Permit dynamodb:GetItem and dynamodb:PutItem only on arn:aws:dynamodb:us-east-1:123456789012:table/TrainingUsers. Do not include Principal or wildcard resources.

Return a single JSON object containing a Secrets Manager GetSecretValue request for arn:aws:secretsmanager:us-east-1:123456789012:secret:training/api-key-AbCdEf. Explicitly request VersionStage AWSCURRENT and omit VersionId.

Return a single JSON object containing an SNS message filtering policy. Match eventType equal to order_created and amount numerically greater than or equal to 100. Use the SNS numeric condition syntax and do not include a subscription configuration wrapper.

Return a single JavaScript-compatible regex literal with no flags that matches an entire AWS account ID consisting of exactly 12 ASCII digits. Reject surrounding whitespace and any trailing line terminator.

Return a single JavaScript-compatible regex literal with no flags that matches an entire EC2 instance ID beginning with i- followed by exactly 17 lowercase hexadecimal characters. Reject legacy 8-character IDs and any trailing characters, including line terminators.

Return a single JavaScript-compatible regex literal with no flags that matches an entire EBS volume ID beginning with vol- followed by exactly 17 lowercase hexadecimal characters. Reject uppercase hexadecimal letters and trailing line terminators.

Return a single JavaScript-compatible regex literal with no flags that matches an entire VPC ID beginning with vpc- followed by either 8 or 17 lowercase hexadecimal characters. Reject every other length and trailing line terminators.

Return a single JavaScript-compatible regex literal with no flags that matches an entire subnet ID beginning with subnet- followed by exactly 17 lowercase hexadecimal characters. Reject surrounding whitespace and trailing line terminators.

Return a single JavaScript-compatible regex literal with no flags that matches an entire IAM role ARN restricted to arn:aws:iam::<12-digit-account>:role/<role-name>, without a path. The role name must contain 1 to 64 characters drawn only from ASCII letters, digits, underscore, plus, equals, comma, period, at sign, and hyphen. Reject trailing line terminators.

Return a single JavaScript-compatible regex literal with no flags that matches an entire SQS FIFO queue name. Require a base of 1 to 75 ASCII letters, digits, underscores, or hyphens followed by the literal suffix .fifo. Reject other characters and trailing line terminators.

Return a single JavaScript-compatible regex literal with no flags that matches an entire standard SQS queue URL limited to https://sqs.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/<12-digit-account>/<queue-name>. The queue name must contain 1 to 80 ASCII letters, digits, underscores, or hyphens. Reject query strings, trailing slashes, and trailing line terminators.

Return a single JavaScript-compatible regex literal with no flags that matches an entire CloudWatch log group name containing 1 to 512 characters drawn only from ASCII letters, digits, period, hyphen, underscore, slash, and hash. Reject names beginning with the exact case-sensitive prefix aws: and reject trailing line terminators.

Return a single JavaScript-compatible regex literal with no flags that matches an entire Lambda request ID in the lowercase UUID-shaped form 8-4-4-4-12 hexadecimal characters. Validate only this shape, without enforcing UUID version or variant bits, and reject trailing line terminators.

Return a single JavaScript-compatible regex literal with no flags that matches an entire Lambda function name containing 1 to 64 ASCII letters, digits, underscores, or hyphens. Reject ARNs, version suffixes, and trailing line terminators.

Return a single JavaScript-compatible regex literal with no flags that matches an entire DynamoDB table name containing 3 to 255 ASCII letters, digits, underscores, hyphens, or periods. Reject surrounding whitespace and trailing line terminators.

Return a single JavaScript-compatible regex literal with no flags that matches an entire S3 object key of the form logs/YYYY/MM/DD/file.json. Validate only the shape: YYYY is four ASCII digits, MM is 01 through 12, DD is 01 through 31, and file is one or more ASCII letters, digits, underscores, or hyphens. Do not validate actual calendar dates. Reject trailing line terminators.

Return a single JavaScript-compatible regex literal with no flags that matches an entire string in the form arn:aws:lambda:us-east-1:<12-digit-account>:function:<name> and captures the function name in group 1. The name must contain 1 to 64 ASCII letters, digits, underscores, or hyphens. Reject aliases, version suffixes, and trailing line terminators.

Return a single JavaScript-compatible regex literal with no flags that matches an entire unqualified ECR image URI of the form <12-digit-account>.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/<repository>:<tag>. Restrict repository to one path segment of 2 to 30 lowercase ASCII letters, digits, or hyphens, starting with a lowercase letter. Restrict tag to 1 to 20 ASCII letters, digits, underscores, or hyphens. Reject digests, slashes in the repository, and trailing line terminators.

Return a single JavaScript-compatible regex literal with no flags that matches an entire EventBridge event bus ARN of the form arn:aws:events:us-east-1:<12-digit-account>:event-bus/<name>. Restrict the name to 1 to 256 ASCII letters, digits, underscores, periods, or hyphens. Reject trailing line terminators and any additional path segments.
